source: Drone 1 as the 2026-11-15 bursts flew it: airframe_2026-11-12_raised.json with the bands off (left_band and right_band 0, since about 06:20 UTC; fly it with no tilt offset) and the terms the three bursts fit jointly on all three axes (sw/sim/burst_replay.py: 05:29 burst90 with the bands, 07:03 burst60 to 13.45 s and 07:13 burst30 without; the plant driven open loop by each log's throttles and servos on the 2026-11-14 stand's thrust table, body rates, attitude and velocity (from the logged attitude and specific force) set back to the log's every 0.05 s): the tilt's pitch authority 1.95x the geometry's (tilt_authority), the servos 47 ms late with wn 31 (the hold needs 31 or more on this authority to shake as the drone did rather than diverge), the assemblies' swing reaction at about the CAD's (servo_inertia 0.00027), yaw's tilt authority 1 - wash 0.62 (0.30 before), prop_torque -0.0118, yaw_from_roll 0.0268; the speed moments to 8 m/s (speed_range; rigid.py otherwise clipped them at 1.5 m/s and faded them with the tilt) with the forward speed's 4.9x the hover fit's (vx_drag 0.341) and a quadratic part (speed_moment2 0.00506): the bursts reach 4-6 m/s, and the 07:03 burst60's second swing (the nose down at 585 deg/s to +78-88 degrees) is that moment, not the tilt; and thrust lost with climb along the shafts, climb_inflow 0.03 per m/s (weak). Closed loop (flip_firmware.py, quaternion 1, indi 0.5) the hold shakes at 2.6 Hz with 8 deg/s RMS pitch rate as the drone did (2.35-2.4 Hz, 8-11 deg/s in 2-4 Hz), and the as-flown burst60 peaks at 68 degrees of pitch (46-76, 10th-90th) and 441 deg/s nose down (248-669), the drone 88 and 585. models/NOTES.md 'The bursts' plant'.
